messages:
devon: Heads-up — planning a kernel + quant profile rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. Kernel v2.3.1 + new quant profile q4_1b_fast. Staggered plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2h. Owner: @taylor. Need smoke sign-off from infra + SRE. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/3456

taylor: I'll take ownership of the canary window. Can someone confirm the rollback image and helm revision? Also are any feature flags changing?

raj: Rollback image is runtime:2.3.0-build-1472, quant fallback is q4_1b_safe. Helm rollback revision pinned to previous release. No new feature flags except the quant profile toggle; keep model-quant-caching disabled for canary. I ran quick perf tests locally — tail latency looks OK.

lin: Preflight plan: I'll run the preflight 20m before deploy on canary-pool-3. Smoke checklist here:
```
# smoke checks
./deploy/tools/smoke_check --target canary-pool-3
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l release=canary
curl -sS http://canary.internal/health | jq .
# sample inference test
python tools/run_infer.py --model small --prompt "hello"
```
I'll also seed the canary with a canonical prompt set and confirm outputs match baseline.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @taylor for 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z · CID d-89a3 · Canary pool: canary-pool-3 · Actions: preflight -> canary -> rollout

maria: I'll monitor latency and qps. Creating a short Grafana panel and an alert: 95p latency increase > 20% for 5m, and error rate > 0.5% for 3m. I'll set dashboard refresh to 1m and post link when ready. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: I'll be on pager for the window. Rollback trigger: error rate >0.5% for 5m OR 95p latency >25% for 5m. If triggered, policy is immediate rollback and abort rollout. Also, if we see OOMs, try canary with `--kv-cache=false` before rollback. Ping me with `@sre-oncall rollback` to initiate.

taylor: Copy. I'll post canary-up and smoke results in this thread. @raj please have the helm rollback command and the rollback image SHA in the channel prior to canary start. @maria thanks — ping when panel ready.

raj: Helm rollback command (ready): `helm rollback runtime -n runtime 3` (3 corresponds to v2.3.0-rollback). Rollback image staged: sha256:abc123def4567890. I also uploaded the staged image to the private registry.

lin: Preflight passed on staging, no regressions on the canonical prompt set. I'll start canary at 23:05 UTC (5m after scheduled) to give teams time to watch preflight. Canary tracing prefix will be tracing/rollouts/canary-1876543210.

devon: Note: do NOT enable model-quant-caching feature flag during canary. Also please approve PR #3456 if you are a reviewer. We want the runtime config change in place before canary.

taylor: Approving PR now. If anyone doesn't explicitly approve within 30m, assume tacit ack for the rollout. I'll DM @sre-oncall if we need immediate rollback.

maria: Dashboard and alert created: /dashboards/runtime/quant-rollout (link posted). Alert channel set to #eng-runtime-alerts. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: I'll be standing by. If you need me to execute rollback I will run the helm command and notify infra.

taylor: Thanks all — I'll update the thread at each stage (canary-up, canary-smoke-pass, 10%-started, 50%-started, 100%-complete). Please keep replies short so the thread is readable.

devon: One small reminder — log-level set to info for canary to avoid overload; increase to debug only if chasing an actual issue.

maria: :thumbsup:

raj: Image + helm ready.

lin: Starting canary in ~2m.

taylor: Roger.
